name: graphe
description: The Graphe tab of /panel, also opened by /graphe [recherche]: the pane draws the writings graph in ASCII: a force-directed layout of the strongest nodes, or of one node and its neighbours. Live centre: the pane re-centres on the node closest to the conversation (words of your last prompts, then Haiku to break a tie) until you pin one with /graphe <recherche>

journal.title: Build journal
journal.description: JSON-lines file whose last line describes the last build

centrage.title: Live centre
centrage.description: haiku: the words of your last prompts, with Haiku to break a tie or a miss; lexical: the words alone; off: the pane never follows the conversation

lang.title: Language
lang.description: fr: the pane and the replies in French; en: in English. The graph data (ids, relations, quotes) is shown as written
